scientific_integrity: Exhaustive combinatorial proof and complete integer census with two independent cycle generators and two independent palindrome detectors; no symbolic infinite-order extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Order-five binary cycles, rotation classes only, circular factors of lengths 1 through 32, distinct literal palindromes. Exact finite exhaustive proof requiring replay of supplied standard-library code. Simpson 2014 full original text inaccessible; historical priority and independent validation unconfirmed.
title: Complete joint palindromic spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
